Public tools · Downloads

Vintorent download manager

Vintorent is a public browser tool from Vintorex Digital Solutions. Paste a page to find downloadable files, add a torrent, upscale an image, or analyse a public social profile.

Analyse and download a video

Paste a public YouTube, Vimeo or Dailymotion video link above to see its title, creator, duration and available formats. Choose an available MP4 resolution up to 1080p or MP3 audio. The server prepares your file before the browser saves it. Limits are one hour and 256 MB per file.

Transfers

What can I save from a public page?

Vintorent looks for media, documents, images and archives linked in the page HTML. Select a file to save it. An embedded player may be viewable even when it offers no downloadable file.

Which pages work?

Paste a public page to find linked media, documents and archives, or paste a file URL directly. Choose a discovered file to save it through your browser. Some sites require sign-in or create their links only after playback starts.

How do torrents work?

Keep this tab open while downloading. Browser torrents need WebRTC peers and compatible trackers. Select a file to retrieve it. Large transfers depend on your device’s memory.

Image tools

Image upscaler

Enlarge a PNG, JPEG or WebP image using smooth interpolation. Each upload automatically uses the largest size that fits 32 megapixels and 8,192 pixels per side, preserving its proportions. Your image stays in this browser.

Compare images

Download PNG

How large can I make an image?

Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 32 MB. Maximum size preserves the proportions and targets up to 32 megapixels, with neither side exceeding 8,192 pixels. You can also choose 2×, 3× or 4× within those limits.

How do I compare the original and the upscaled PNG?

After processing, move the slider to compare both images at the same display size. Vintorent shows the original and output dimensions, the extra pixels and the change in total pixel count. A 3× increase in each dimension produces nine times as many pixels. Processing and comparison happen in your browser.

Social analytics

Profile analyser

Look up Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Bluesky or YouTube profiles. Available statistics depend on the platform.

Which profile statistics are available?

YouTube can show public channel details and displayed subscriber counts. Instagram can show published follower, following and post counts. Bluesky also supports paginated follower and following lists. Other networks may expose only a profile name or description.

Does Vintorent show actual YouTube earnings?

The calculator estimates revenue using the views and creator RPM you enter for the same period: views × RPM ÷ 1,000. For Shorts, use engaged views. Actual revenue and watch time require authorised channel analytics.
